description: Source code implementing HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) functions with support for multiple cryptographic libraries, including OpenSSL, mbedTLS, wolfSSL, nettle, gnutls, and NSS. Contains functions for MD5, SHA1, SHA256, and SHA512 HMACs, with conditional compilation based on available libraries.

methods.name: li_hmac_md5
methods.description: Computes MD5 HMAC of input message with a secret key.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA1 HMAC of input message with a secret key, supporting multiple crypto libraries.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Computes SHA256 HMAC of input message with a secret key, supporting multiple crypto libraries.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha512
methods.description: Computes SHA512 HMAC of input message with a secret key, supporting multiple crypto libraries.
